FIELDWORK / SCIENTIFIC BRIEF / OFFICIAL TEACHING DATA

Yellow-bellied Sapsucker
in Michigan

Sphyrapicus varius · Status 2023 · Breeding trends 2012–2022

Question

How does modeled relative abundance vary across the year, and how do estimated breeding trends differ between broad analytical regions?

Results

The area-weighted annual cycle peaks on 2023-04-19 at 0.649 relative abundance units across the supported Michigan cells. This is a seasonal pattern in a single Status release, not a population trend.

The separate Trends release yields an abundance-and-area-weighted regional trend of -0.84% per year (80% ensemble interval -1.06% to -0.20%). Its interval-based direction is declining.

RegionAnnual trend80% intervalDirection
all-0.84%-1.06% to -0.20%declining
central-0.19%-0.56% to +0.42%uncertain
north-1.20%-1.69% to -0.50%declining
south+0.59%-0.04% to +1.02%uncertain

Northern, central, and southern bands use 45.5°N and 44°N boundaries. They demonstrate a custom area-of-interest request; they are not ecological or administrative units.

Interpretation for conservation

Use these summaries to frame follow-up investigations and monitoring discussions. Resolve local habitat, detectability, sample support, management feasibility, and uncertainty before identifying an intervention. A coarse teaching subset cannot establish parcel-level priorities or causal habitat effects.

Methods

R ebirdst downloads the official sample. terra crops GeoTIFFs before reading cell arrays. sf intersects 27 km cells and regions in an equal-area CRS. Weekly summaries weight model values by intersection area and retain true zeros. Missing support is excluded and reported. WorldClim 2.1 SRTM-derived elevation is averaged onto the Status grid as a covariate preparation example.

Trends are processed on their own sinusoidal grid. For each of 100 source ensemble replicates, cell trends are weighted by relative abundance × area. The regional median, 10th percentile and 90th percentile are then calculated across replicates. Averaging cell confidence bounds would not provide regional uncertainty.

Separate observational experiment

The auk example contains 729 Singapore sampling events. Filtering leaves 204 independent eligible visits: 67 detections and 137 non-detections of Collared Kingfisher. Prevalence, effort-only logistic regression, and effort-plus-space-and-season logistic regression are compared with held-out spatial groups. This does not validate Cornell's Michigan model.

Reproducibility

Run d9ba95255f0e; seed 20260916. Input checksums, source fingerprints, versions and configuration are in the downloadable manifest. Results are a portfolio demonstration, not a Cornell-endorsed product.
